description: One entry in the current Indore council CMS; not election-time winners. The unlabeled entry is not assigned a ward.

fields.name: source_entry_id
fields.description: Unique CMS entry identifier; not a ward number.

fields.name: ward_no
fields.description: Printed ward number; null only for the roster's unlabeled entry.

fields.name: ward_label_raw
fields.description: Original ward-number label, including an empty string.

fields.name: title_raw
fields.description: Original title, including honorific or court-status text; null if absent.

fields.name: member_woman_from_honorific
fields.description: 1 for Mrs./Ms., 0 for Mr., null otherwise. Applies only to this roster entry; does not measure 2022 winner sex.

fields.name: source_updated_at
fields.description: Original CMS updatedAt timestamp; not an election date.

fields.name: retrieved_at
fields.description: UTC source retrieval timestamp from the acquisition receipt.

fields.name: source_status
fields.description: Evidence status; current roster is not an election result.

fields.name: source_path
fields.description: Original file path relative to the repository root.

fields.name: source_sha256
fields.description: SHA-256 of the complete original source bytes.

fields.name: source_row
fields.description: One-based extracted list or CMS array position.
